evals.prompt: We just finished Phase 12 yesterday and the sub-agent confirmed everything passed. The wiki hasn't been touched since Phase 9. Can you reconcile the wiki?
evals.expected_output: Agent reads log.md, reads TASKS.md, identifies phases 10-12 as complete, updates overview.md with those phases, supersedes any open defects that were resolved in the log, and appends a reconcile log entry.

evals.prompt: We patched the Telegram webhook secret token bug last week. I'm worried the wiki still describes it as a missing feature.
evals.expected_output: Agent checks log.md for the Telegram secret token fix, finds the wiki page that describes it as a gap/vulnerability, supersedes it with the resolution, and logs the reconcile pass.

evals.prompt: reconcile the wiki — we've applied about 4 new migrations since the last update and I think Database.md is totally out of date
evals.expected_output: Agent reads Database.md, reads all migration files in backend/migrations/, identifies tables/columns added or dropped since the last wiki update, updates Database.md with new tables and supersedes dropped columns, and logs the result.
